purpose: Lexical correction to revision 5: falsify residual T-11 through the standard decision-problem names circuit nonconstancy, constancy, equivalence, and identity.

claim_under_test.residual_only: BAD-FIBER for succinct Boolean circuits is NP-complete and exact factorization is coNP-complete.
claim_under_test.polynomial_equivalence_to_check: Set the observation circuit G constant and add a selector input b to f(x,b)=b AND C(x). A bad fiber exists iff C is satisfiable. The complement asks whether f is constant on G-fibers.

queries: Boolean circuit identity testing coNP complete
full_text_policy: Retrieve only sources that explicitly classify circuit nonconstancy, constancy, equivalence, identity, or tautology and can support the stated polynomial equivalence.

include_if: title or abstract explicitly classifies Boolean circuit nonconstancy, constancy, equivalence, identity, or tautology
paper or authoritative source states the relevant NP/coNP completeness under succinct circuit input
exclude_if: polynomial identity testing for arithmetic circuits
restricted circuit class without transfer to unrestricted circuits
SAT solver performance without a complexity classification

falsifier: An established NP-completeness result for Boolean circuit nonconstancy/SAT or coNP-completeness result for circuit constancy/equivalence/tautology, combined with the explicit polynomial reduction to T-11.
non_falsifier: Absence of search results remains non-evidence of novelty.
stop_conditions: Do not follow references or cited-by edges.
Do not modify the active ten-record corpus.
If a standard completeness result plus the explicit reduction settles T-11, mark residual novelty falsified and stop.

execution_gate.scope: Six lexical-correction OpenAlex searches, at most 60 isolated candidates, no reference expansion, and only decisive targeted source retrieval.
execution_gate.candidate_ledger_redaction: Public URL values are replaced by sha256:<digest>; bibliographic content, DOI, provider IDs, abstracts, and query provenance are retained.
